description: Networks and network devices are not secured, managed, and controlled to protect information. This signal indicates that network infrastructure lacks appropriate security controls such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention, network access controls, secure configurations, or monitoring capabilities.
applicability: Applicable to all network infrastructure including physical networks, virtual networks, software-defined networks, cloud networking, wireless networks, and network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network security appliances.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through network architecture review, firewall rule analysis, network device configuration audits, security group assessments, network monitoring system evaluations, and penetration testing results. May also be identified through network traffic analysis and security posture assessments.
